hints.title: Ratio Equation Transformation
hints.text: The condition count(0) / count(1) == num1 / num2 is equivalent to num2 * count(0) - num1 * count(1) == 0.

hints.title: Weighted Balance Values
hints.text: Assign weight +num2 to character '0' and weight -num1 to character '1'. A valid substring has total weight sum 0.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Frequency Hash
hints.text: Compute running prefix sums of weights. Substrings with sum 0 correspond to pairs of equal prefix sum indices.

hints.title: Weighted Prefix Sum Balance Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import defaultdict

class Solution:
    def fixedRatio(self, s: str, num1: int, num2: int) -> int:
        counts = defaultdict(int)
        counts[0] = 1
        cur = 0
        ans = 0
        for c in s:
            if c == '0':
                cur += num2
            else:
                cur -= num1
            ans += counts[cur]
            counts[cur] += 1
        return ans
```

variables: n: length of binary string s
complexity.notes: Single pass accumulating weighted prefix balance.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking ratios across all O(n^2) substrings causes quadratic time limits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary space to map prefix sum frequencies.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Translates ratio equation into zero-sum prefix problem using cross-multiplied weights.
